changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A lineage row names a problem of the newer result, of the previous one, or both, as its comparison says. Its results and problems belong to its workspace, and a row goes with either result. Each side has one index that leads with both of its keys: the result key, and the problem key in any column order. So a delete of a result or a problem finds its rows without a scan. On the newer side, that index is uk_problem_lineage_problem.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE problem_lineage ADD CONSTRAINT ck_problem_lineage_comparison CHECK (comparison IN ('ABSENT', 'NEW', 'UNCHANGED', 'UPDATED')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_problem_lineage_sides CHECK ( (comparison = 'NEW' AND problem_id IS NOT NULL AND prior_problem_id IS NULL) OR (comparison = 'ABSENT' AND problem_id IS NULL AND prior_problem_id IS NOT NULL) OR (comparison IN ('UNCHANGED', 'UPDATED') AND problem_id IS NOT NULL AND prior_problem_id IS NOT NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_problem_lineage_results CHECK (result_id <> prior_result_id), ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_problem_lineage_result FOREIGN KEY (result_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES result(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_problem_lineage_prior_result FOREIGN KEY (prior_result_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES result(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_problem_lineage_problem FOREIGN KEY (problem_id, result_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES problem(id, result_id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_problem_lineage_prior_problem FOREIGN KEY (prior_problem_id, prior_result_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES problem(id, result_id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE; CREATE INDEX idx_problem_lineage_prior ON problem_lineage (prior_result_id, workspace_id, prior_problem_id);

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_problem_lineage_prior; ALTER TABLE problem_lineage DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS sfk_problem_lineage_prior_problem, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS sfk_problem_lineage_problem, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS sfk_problem_lineage_prior_result, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS sfk_problem_lineage_result, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_problem_lineage_results, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_problem_lineage_sides, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_problem_lineage_comparison;
